phase: four-fold single-seed screening with internal candidate selection
checkpoint_selection: minimum unweighted validation BCE; strict lower only
AMP: fp16 initial scale128, record skipped steps
no_lora_definition: physically unwrap all LoRALinear into frozen base Linear; same already-initialized Mamba/head
compare: same initial head hash, same batch permutations; adapter dropout consumes additional RNG so exact dropout streams not matched
promotion: no deployment; validate selected configuration across folds/seeds before any improvement claim
historical_fold0_test: already examined; not a new blind test
smoke: 2 actual optimizer attempts per arm only, no performance claim
prior_fold0: previously inspected exploratory reference, reported separately
role_integrity: each outer fold uses disjoint sequence groups among train/validation/calibration/test
predeclared_comparisons: selected LoRA by validation BCE against no LoRA; all 3 arms exploratory
pool_primary: out-of-fold rows from folds 1-4 pooled; fold0 separate and optional five-fold descriptive only
fusion_scope: conditional historical 3D OOF; not independently nested training
multiple_seeds: not yet; add if screening suggests promise
uncertainty: paired group bootstrap conditional on trained predictions; not seed/fold training variation
